_comment: F248 plan for the Getting started space (static/starter-everyday.ttl). Which SAMPLE source each fact came from, the words its passage must contain, who settled it, when, and the review history. Hand-written; the source TEXTS are drafted by a local model (draft-sample-sources.ts) and approved by Matt. Every source is fictional and labelled as a sample. A fact is named subject|predicate|object, using the local names in the starter (an entity object by its local name, a literal by its exact value). Facts not listed here stay as curated, confirmed and unsourced: types, labels, icons, photos, links, coordinates and the reasoning edges (ruled-out-by, for, part-of). Each fact carries `say`, the fact as a plain sentence for the drafting model, which contains every `must` string. `by` (thread facts): the passage must come from that person's own message, so a fact about Alex is never evidenced by Jordan's words.
trip: Alex (San Francisco) and Jordan (Los Angeles) meet halfway for a camping weekend in the Eastern Sierra, Fri July 10 to Sun July 12, 2026, choosing between two campgrounds: Lake George (Mammoth Lakes basin) and Oh! Ridge (June Lake Loop). They must book by Wednesday July 8.

sources.title: Sample: text thread, Alex and Jordan
sources.style: A text-message thread between two old friends, Alex and Jordan, planning the trip over two evenings. Each message starts with the sender's name and a colon. Casual, short messages, about 18 to 26 lines.
